summary: Watch is now an independent cinema-oriented interface: film catalog uses a light local navigation and adaptive posters, My Lists uses status shelves, and Recent Opens uses true dated rows; no Music-style sidebar. Also includes P01 local subsite-management enhancements already merged to main. Existing canonical Watch identity, data, privacy, auth, security, schema, installer and updater mechanisms remain unchanged. Production remains OWNER manual; Preview and Real Use await post-release/post-upgrade assessment.
